row.team_price_text: Pro: $15/mo billed annually (2,400 credits/yr, 5 users included); $20/mo monthly
row.evidence: LeadIQ's help centre lists "SCIM (Auto Provisioning/Deprovisioning)" among its SSO identity types and says "If you are on the Enterprise plan, you can speak with your Account Manager about starting the configuration"; Enterprise is Contact us on the pricing page.
row.notes: New row. Pro is priced by credits with 5 users included (from $15/mo billed annually for 2,400 credits/yr; $20 monthly), so per-user fields stay null; SSO is an Enterprise (Contact us) feature that LeadIQ's team configures (the help article also calls it an add-on for some plans). SCIM is an Okta 'SCIM app' (create, name updates, deactivate, group sync via Okta); SCIM unassignment marks the user inactive and frees the license seat. No public SCIM endpoint, token or other-IdP instructions, and LeadIQ is not in the Okta Integration Network search, so idp values stay null and generic false. The Public API is enrichment data only.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $15.00/month billed annually (2,400 credits/yr), 5 users included; $20.00/month billed monthly
plans.notes: Price scales with the credit slider; the quoted price is the lowest credit tier.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual plan only per pricing page.

operations.notes: Name updates from the IdP are synced (c12); HTTP methods are not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User is tagged inactive and cannot log in; team admins keep access to the user's lead captures; admins can still remove the user from the team in the web app.

roles.how: Inactive users' roles cannot be edited; roles are assigned on the Team page, not via SCIM (no SCIM role mapping documented).

limitations.text: Users already in another LeadIQ team cannot be assigned to a new team via SCIM.
Only Okta is named for SCIM and SCIM groups; other IdPs are not documented, and LeadIQ is not found in the Okta Integration Network search.

scim.notes: SCIM is delivered as an Okta 'SCIM app' set up with LeadIQ's customer experience team; no SCIM base URL, token or endpoint list is published.

user_api.notes: The LeadIQ Public API is a prospecting/enrichment data API (people and company lookups); no user, team or license management endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN search finds no LeadIQ app, though LeadIQ's help centre describes an Okta SCIM app.

fallbacks.notes: SSO users must already be invited to the team with a matching email (no JIT).
